correctness.rationale: Exact rational substitution verifies the nonzero equilibrium. The bundled independent algebraic replay expands \(\det(\lambda I-J(E_*))\) directly from the Jacobian, recovers the stated integer polynomial, and verifies all positive coefficients together with the exact positive quartic Hurwitz determinants \(\Delta_2=1850867402738339250\) and \(\Delta_3=23033184284619159659128251000\). The Routh–Hurwitz criterion therefore places every root in the open left half-plane. Approximate roots are only a readability check and are not used as the proof.

value.rationale: The sign correction changes the qualitative dynamics at the parameter vector used as the paper’s pseudorandom hyperchaotic generator. A stable hyperbolic equilibrium has an open basin, so any chaotic invariant set at the same parameters is necessarily accompanied by a stable steady-state basin. This is structurally and application-relevant, not a cosmetic numerical refinement.
